description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing VSOCK connections, including client and server variants, with methods for connecting, disconnecting, reading, writing, and handling JSON messages.

classes.name: VsockConnection
classes.description: Abstract base class for VSOCK connections, providing interface for connection management, data transfer, and message handling.

classes.name: VsockClientConnection
classes.description: Concrete class implementing VSOCK client connection logic.

classes.name: VsockServerConnection
classes.description: Concrete class implementing VSOCK server connection logic, including server shutdown.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a VSOCK connection to a specified port and CID, optionally with a vhost user CID.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the VSOCK connection.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to establish a VSOCK connection.

methods.name: SetDisconnectCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be invoked upon disconnection.

methods.name: IsConnected_Unguarded
methods.description: Checks connection status without locking.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks connection status with thread safety.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Checks if data is available to read.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a single integer data from the connection.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of data into a vector.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads data of specified size.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message into a buffer.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message and returns it as a vector.

methods.name: ReadMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a message.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessage
methods.description: Reads a JSON message.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a JSON message.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes an integer data.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes raw data from a buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a vector.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a string message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a vector message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Sends a JSON message.

methods.name: WriteStrides
methods.description: Writes data with specified strides.

methods.name: ServerShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server connection.
